sentences.text: (Dated this the 4th day of April 2025)
The petitioners are small holders of land in R.S.136 of Chirakkal Amsom, Puzhathi Desom, Kannur District, that has been acquired for the widening of the National Highway.

Though they produced their title deeds with respect to their properties before the competent authority, an award was passed, but the payment was not effected, and the compensation was deposited in Civil Court under Section 3H of the National Highways Act.

2. The counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have no title disputes and no rival claims over the properties, and the court below ought to have disbursed the compensation at the earliest.
Since no orders were passed, this original petition is filed for a direction to take up LAR Nos.01, 07, 08, 10 and 11 of 2024 and dispose of 2025:KER:30183 the same within a time frame.
3. It is submitted that except L.A.R. Nos.20 & 33 of 2024, all the above-mentioned references were posted on 18.10.2024 for the appearance of the respondents.
The case was posted to 05.04.2025 for the counter of the petitioner/Special Tahsildar.

4. Heard counsel on either side.
5.
The review petitioners in the R.P. claimed that they are entitled to compensation for the land acquired and they are necessary parties in the land acquisition reference.

Therefore, liberty is given to the review petitioners to file impleading petition in the L.A.Rs within 2 weeks, after summer holidays and after the impleading petitions are filed, the same shall be taken into consideration and dispose of the same, in accordance with law.

The court below shall afford opportunity of hearing to all the parties, 2025:KER:30183 including the Review Petitioners in the R.P., and pronounce the final judgment in the L.A.Rs on or before 31st July 2025.
If the impleading petitions are not filed before the time prescribed, L.A.Rs shall be taken for orders, without impleading them in the party array.
The Original Petition is disposed of as above.
